rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst, including expanded cavity, thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. It is detailed, though some image-specific claims such as exact clock-face position and absence of multinucleation/granularity may be overinterpreted from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior failed cycles, endometrial thickness, BMI, and male factor/paternal age with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and age-related aneuploidy to implantation estimate. Minor issues include somewhat speculative attribution to sperm DNA fragmentation and strong inference from AMH to oocyte quality.

Morphology interpretation and general prognosis are aligned with standard IVF practice, but recommendations such as routine assisted hatching, low-dose aspirin, ERA after two failed cycles, and broad thrombophilia/autoimmune testing are not strongly guideline-supported for routine use.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning, including sperm DNA fragmentation testing and future cycle considerations. Some suggestions are practical, though a few are more speculative than standard-of-care.
